item.subject: maths
item.stem:
Yash looks at the diagram of a pentagon on a $1\,\mathrm{cm}^{2}$ grid. Dashed lines from one vertex split the pentagon into triangles. He wants the area of the pentagon in square centimetres.

Which claim correctly tells how to find that area?

options.A: Find the area of each triangle from the dashed split, then add those areas.
options.B: Report the word pentagon as the area on the grid.
options.C: Splitting into triangles is what creates the pentagon on the grid.
options.D: The area equals $1$ because the grid is labelled $1\,\mathrm{cm}^{2}$.
